cause: Q2'24 revenue $189M (vs $98.4M prior year) and net income $30.6M (vs $12.7M) far exceeded prior year on higher SWU volumes/pricing, plus a $900M LEU purchase commitment announcement and active HALEU/DOE domestic enrichment RFP participation backed by $3.4B in congressional funding
quality: 混合/波动大: revenue and earnings genuinely more than doubled YoY, but LEU segment gross margin nearly halved YTD (19.5% vs 39% prior year) purely on contract delivery timing (per management, not structural), no full-year guidance given, and the $900M commercial commitment plus DOE contracts are both contingent/competitive, not secured revenue
reason: The domestic uranium enrichment security narrative (Russia import ban effective Aug 11 2024, $3.4B in government funding for HALEU/LEU capacity) is a real structural, policy-backed tailwind and the earnings beat itself is genuine (net income +141% YoY). However, results are explicitly described by management as lumpy/timing-dependent, margins compressed sharply, and both the $900M commercial book and DOE contract awards are conditional/competitive with 'no guarantees' - so this is a speculative strategic-theme stock, not a clean operating beat, and conviction should be low even while leaning to hold the position given the policy tailwind.
red_flags: LEU分部毛利率同比腰斩(39%→19.5%,管理层称为交付时点问题非结构性);$900M商业承诺以能否融资建新产能为前提,尚未落地;DOE合同为竞争性招标,无保证;俄罗斯进口禁令带来供应链依赖政府豁免的不确定性
